name: filtered-p1-twin
description: Created 2026-11-12 ~14:40 from filtered-p1-twin.DRAFT.json (2026-11-12 ~12:20, the train_filter build; ~13:50 cold share 1.0 as filtered-p1's). The unfiltered TWIN of filtered-p1 (analyst 6.85 (b): its predictions are filtered against an unfiltered mixed twin; whether to run it is the user's call): filtered-p1's spec without train_filter and self_games_topup, so every line trains on the whole local set (round-robins, self-games and, with train, the cold games). Lines (the six of update 8 at ply 1, analyst 6.84 (2) / 6.85 (b)): F-L; F-P; T-P-Ne-grow with the leaf bar on (--grow-mdl 1 --grow-gate age --grow-priority snapshot); T-P-Ne capped (limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03); T-L-Ne capped forget 10 (limit 4, 1M). The optional sixth seat, T-L-Ne-grow-f10, is one more models row ({"model": "T-L-Ne-grow-f10"}; 6 lines: 12 entries, 12 rounds, plateau K 29); a router-split DAG seat only if grow-dag-p1 reads well against strangers (6.80's rule). Ply 1, games_per_cycle 1584 (5 lines: 10 entries, 18 double round-robins, 1,620 games), self-games, cold_games T 0.02 share 1.0 (the user, 13:22: "play more games per round so that the standard error is lower": 18 cold double round-robins, 1,620 games, 324 an entry, so a current version's SE is ~22-26 against ~47-55 at share 0.25 (the cold twins' current versions: median 40-47 on 98 games); every decision on the cold fit). End rule (the user's): no retirement (experiments never retire), crownings at the default 2.0 SE on the cold set (11-12 13:21: champion_se 2.5 dropped; the cold twins crowned at 2.0 as often as the T 0.1 runs, and 2.5 would have halved their crownings: z of every champion test in their cycles.csv; analyst 6.89 (a) flagged it; the user's end rule: "just like experiments do"), plateau scaled (K 32 for 5 lines) from cycle 300, cap 600. Seed 63 (62 is grow-dag-p1's draft). Games chessai-hybrid17; after create, before cycle 1: python3 leagues/specs/ply1/train_binary.py --from chessai-hybrid4gfx leagues/experiments/NAME chessai-hybrid6 (F-L, F-P and the capped trees; T-P-Ne-grow keeps its recipe's chessai-grow4, T-L-Ne-grow-f10 chessai-grow5). cold_games.train is FALSE (11-12 14:21, 6.82's twins: the tree field passed but the F-P field failed the rule at the end, coldtrain - coldrate -28 [-50, -6] at ply 1 v299 against the F-P panel, so by the user's 10:54 rule the cold games rate only; at share 1.0 they would also be about half the training data, a dose never tested): the cold games rate and decide, the T 0.1 round-robins and self-games train. The filtered run and its twin carry the same value. Predictions (6.85 (b)), filtered minus its unfiltered twin against the standing ply-1 panel: flats 10-30 better, trees 0-40 better (6.78 (a)'s uniform-tree effect); the ranking unchanged (trees over flats by 60-110 against the mixed panel, 40-70 of it matchup); at ply 2 everything within 30. What it is for: the comparator. Every line trains on the whole local set; filtered-p1 minus this twin is the effect of the filter (the user's rule of 13:22-13:24: a line trains on the games whose players are all rated at or above its current cold Elo minus its standard error, its own games too) with its top-up. Read: the standing ply-1 panel (r + e + g + h at v300), v150, v300 and the final, plies 1 and 2, filtered against twin line by line; each line's kept share, floor and top-up games per cycle from cycles.csv (filter_* and topup_* columns). Cost: ~12 CPU-s a cycle early to ~21-24 late (measured rates of the running ply-1 twins and probit-f10-p1; cold share 1.0 adds ~2-4 CPU-s a cycle over 0.25: 4x the cold games, ~1.2-2 ms CPU each with their fit, and a fit growing 4x faster), ~1.4-3.6 CPU-h over 300-600 cycles. 6.90 (~14:29): run-to-run SD ~35-45 (a run is one sample), so one run per arm resolves only ~90+: this pair is INSIGHT ONLY (the user's framing); a second seed each only if the first pair shows 60+ anywhere. Predictions under the user's rule, filtered - twin against the standing ply-1 panel at v300: trees 0..40, flats -10..20, ply 2 within 30, ranking unchanged; the dynamics (kept shares, crowning counts, whether the flats close on the trees) are the result.
